data.exact_reserve_text: A surplus run-off deviation of GBP 1.3 million was experienced in 2014 (2013: GBP 6.4 million surplus). This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 2.0 million on direct business (2013: GBP 3.4 million surplus) and a GBP 0.7 million deficit on reinsurance accepted business (2013: GBP 3.0 million surplus). The direct improvements primarily arose from the fire and other damage to property books and the reinsurance accepted deteriorations primarily arose from a deterioration on the casualty book although this was partly offset by a surplus on the property book (2013: the direct and reinsurance accepted surpluses primarily arose from the fire and other damage to property books).

prior_year_events.event_name: Mining landslide (loss of plant and equipment)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Contributed to the 2012 year loss as a large claim; adverse impact on reserves for that year.
Large contractor liability claim contributing to the 2012 year adverse result.
A number of power claims materially contributed to the 2012 year result; syndicate ceased writing power risks at end of 2012 and purchased quota share protection in 2013.
One large claim relating to the 2013 year of account arisen from a Canadian construction loss.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a small prior year release of GBP 1.3m in 2014, driven by a GBP 2.0m surplus on prior-year direct business (largely from the fire and other damage to property portfolio) partially offset by a GBP 0.7m adverse development on reinsurance accepted business driven by deterioration in the casualty book.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement taken from the narrative note 'Movement in prior year provision for claims outstanding' which provides aggregate surplus/deficit amounts but does not present an explicit labelled 'Insurance liabilities (gross)' column. The GBP 1.3m is therefore treated as a gross prior-year release per the movement note; confidence reduced accordingly. No gross claims development triangle was provided in the extracted pages. Several large prior-year claims are described in narrative but without quantified amounts.
